label.sessionTimeout.subtitle: Control how long users stay signed in and how long security tokens remain valid. Choose seconds, minutes, hours, or days for each field.

label.sessionTimeout.group.general.desc: Default token signing and OAuth 2.0 device / pushed-authorization settings.
label.sessionTimeout.field.defaultSignat: Algorithm used to sign access and ID tokens. RS256 is the most common choice.
label.sessionTimeout.field.oauth2DeviceC: Maximum time before a device code and user code pair expires. A relatively short value is recommended.
label.sessionTimeout.field.oauth2DeviceP: Minimum time in seconds the client should wait between polling requests to the token endpoint.
label.sessionTimeout.field.shortVerifica: Short verification_uri in Device Authorization flow
Optional shorter verification URL shown to users during device authorization (for example, https://example.com/device).
label.sessionTimeout.field.parRequestUri: Lifetime of the Request URI for Pushed Authorization Request
How long a pushed-authorization request URI stays valid. The default is usually 1 minute.
label.sessionTimeout.group.refreshTokens: Controls whether a new refresh token is issued on each refresh request.
label.sessionTimeout.field.revokeRefresh: When enabled, each refresh request issues a new refresh token and invalidates the previous one.
Lifespan of access tokens and related client login timeout.
label.sessionTimeout.field.accessTokenLi: Maximum time before an access token expires. Shorter than SSO Session Idle is recommended.
Access Token Lifespan For Implicit Flow
Maximum time before an access token issued during the implicit OAuth flow expires.
label.sessionTimeout.field.accessCodeLif: Maximum time a client has to finish the login process. The default is usually 30 seconds.
Default lifespans for user- and admin-initiated action links.
label.sessionTimeout.field.actionTokenGe: Default maximum time before a user-initiated action token expires (for example, verify email).
Default maximum time before an administrator-initiated action token expires.
label.sessionTimeout.group.overrideActio: Optional per-action overrides. Leave blank to inherit the default User-Initiated Action Lifespan.
label.sessionTimeout.field.actionTokenVe: Override lifespan for email verification links sent to users.
label.sessionTimeout.field.actionTokenId: Override lifespan for identity-provider account email verification links.
label.sessionTimeout.field.actionTokenFo: Override lifespan for forgot-password / reset-credentials links.
label.sessionTimeout.field.actionTokenEx: Override lifespan for execute-actions links sent to users.
label.sessionTimeout.group.ssoSession.de: Shared sign-on session limits across all applications. SSO Session Max should be greater than or equal to SSO Session Idle.
label.sessionTimeout.field.ssoSessionIdl: Time a session may remain idle before it expires.
label.sessionTimeout.field.ssoSessionMax: Maximum time before a session expires, regardless of activity.
label.sessionTimeout.field.ssoSessionIdl: Same as SSO Session Idle when the user selected Remember Me at login.
label.sessionTimeout.field.ssoSessionMax: Same as SSO Session Max when the user selected Remember Me at login.
label.sessionTimeout.group.clientSession: Per-client session limits. Set 0 to inherit the matching SSO session timeout.
label.sessionTimeout.field.clientSession: Time a client session may remain idle before it expires. 0 inherits SSO Session Idle.
Maximum client session lifetime. 0 inherits SSO Session Max.
label.sessionTimeout.group.offlineSessio: Offline sessions require the offline_access scope.
label.sessionTimeout.field.offlineSessio: Time an offline session may remain idle before it expires.
Maximum offline session lifetime. Applies when Offline Session Max Limited is enabled.
label.sessionTimeout.group.loginSettings: Timeouts while a user completes sign-in or a required login action.
label.sessionTimeout.field.accessCodeLif: Maximum time a user has to complete the login process.
Maximum time a user has to complete a required action during login (for example, update password).
